items.excerpt: The double diamond and design thinking both priced building as the risky step — and generative AI collapsed that price. The author argues what survives is a one-page brief plus a much wider generation step.
An essay on the value of cultural references in design work and the cost of losing them at scale as AI systems generate commercial work without a designer's frame of reference.
A breakdown of why the viral wave of AI-generated food imagery reads as 'slop' to audiences, and what the backlash tells designers about trust and craft signals in generative visuals.
Art schools and drawing classes are being advertised with AI-generated flyers, the latest flashpoint in how generative imagery is displacing commissioned illustration in everyday design work.
A fashion advert styled with cinematic sci-fi production values shows how far small creative teams can now push film-grade look development, and where AI-era ad craft is heading.
Hands-on review of Zoner Studio 2026, an all-in-one photo editor adding AI-assisted editing plus basic video, pitched as a cheaper alternative to the Adobe subscription stack for creatives.
A build log for a Gemini-powered assistant running on Android XR smart glasses, covering the interaction design constraints of a screenless, voice-first multimodal interface.
Blender Studio revealed the teaser for OVERGROWN, its most ambitious open feature film yet — a proof of concept that fully open-source pipelines can hit feature-grade visual quality.
An artist breaks down the workflow for converting a flat 2D illustration into a photoreal two-character 3D scene, covering likeness, cloth and lighting decisions.
A browser tool converts freehand sketches into generative, Minecraft-flavoured music — a small but sharp example of drawing as a direct input modality for generative audio.
Perplexity's portable computer app now runs on Windows accelerated by NVIDIA RTX, pushing local model inference onto the same GPUs creatives already use for rendering.
Shining 3D's EinScan Trak is the company's first 'dual form' scanner, combining handheld and tracked capture modes to move physical objects into CAD and 3D pipelines faster.
CoLab Software's Taylor Young on how design review is being restructured around automated checks and AI assistance rather than meetings and marked-up screenshots.
CoreWeave launched a Physical AI Field Engineering practice aimed at teams training robotics and simulation models, bringing simulation-heavy design workloads onto managed GPU infrastructure.
A writer with no VR development experience shipped an app to the Quest Store in eight days, documenting how far AI coding assistants carry a non-developer through a spatial build.
Valve announced Steam Frame's price, release date and accessories with pre-orders now open — the biggest new target platform spatial designers have had since Quest 3.
Steam Frame lands at $1059 and ships with a standalone build of Half-Life: Alyx, with reservations open now.
Apple shipped iOS 27 with a rebuilt, far more capable Siri — an OS-level assistant layer that changes the interaction patterns app designers have to design around.
Apple's own announcement of Siri AI, detailing on-screen awareness, in-app actions and personal context — the surface designers will be asked to expose their apps through.
Gemini can now organize files inside Google Drive, extending agentic cleanup into the shared folders where design teams keep assets and handoffs.
DesignCourse walks through wiring the ElevenLabs MCP server into Claude so voice and audio generation become a native step inside a designer's build workflow.
THE BRIDGE is a dark-fantasy AI short film built with Seedance 2.5 and GPT Image 2, with an assist from Astra — a full remake that shows where AI film craft now sits.
Source Material episode 4: graphic designer and creative technologist Aitana Pico walks through the books, music and games that shape her visual language.
Zach Lieberman on how John Maeda's Design by Numbers shaped generative and computational design practice.
